name: Squidly
description: Squidly is a bright-eyed, nimble young tiefling child with small horns and a tail, acting as a core member of the alley's urchin network alongside Nat and Jenks. Quick-witted, agile, and always ready with a cheeky grin, he helps scope out buildings, carries messages across the wards, and looks out for his friends with unwavering loyalty.
ideals: Teamwork: 'As long as the three of us stick together, no trouble is too big to slip out of.'
Adventure: 'Helping out the grown-ups with real quests beats scrounging for scraps any day.'
bonds: His fellow street urchins, Nat and Jenks.
Havik and the Trollskull Manor crew, who treat them with kindness and respect.
The hidden rooftops, nooks, and secret shortcuts of the North Ward.
flaws: Prone to taking reckless risks or playing dangerous games of tag across high rooftops when bored.
Easily tempted by sweet treats or shiny baubles left unattended.
speech_patterns: Brisk, playful, and colloquial, speaking with an enthusiastic cadence full of street slang and youthful energy.
mannerisms: Swishes his tail nervously or excitedly when talking, climbs up drainpipes or lintels to get a better vantage point, and flashes wide, disarming grins.
motivations: To earn enough coin to help support his friends and secure warm meals for the group.
To explore every hidden corner of Waterdeep without getting caught by the City Watch.
knowledge: Familiarity with rooftop pathways, sewer grates, neighborhood alleyways, and local gossip across the North and Trades Wards.
gm_notes: Squidly serves as an energetic and endearing street urchin NPC. He can be utilized for nimble rooftop scouting, delivering urgent messages across locked-down wards, or adding emotional depth to the party's community investments around Trollskull Manor.
